simple.meaning: a maggot (as rapidly bred ), literally or figuratively
simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to רִמָּה (H7415) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: n-f.
simple.whyItMatters: This word appears 7 times in the Hebrew Bible, so BibleIQ can compare how Scripture uses it across multiple passages.
simple.summary: רִמָּה (rimmâh) means a maggot (as rapidly bred ), literally or figuratively First listed occurrence: Exod 16 24.

definitions.short: a maggot (as rapidly bred ), literally or figuratively
definitions.full: H7415. rimmah רִמָּה noun feminine worm (cause and sign of decay ); — absolute ׳ר Exod 16:24 (P), Isa 14:11 (|| תּוֺלֵעָה ), Job 7:5 ; 17:14 ; 21:26 ; 24:20 all indicate corruption, feeding on dead, etc.; hyperb. of insignificant man 25:6 (|| תּוֺלֵעָה ).
definitions.rootNote: from 7426 in the sense of breeding (compare 7311 );
